Diego and team,

Thanks for the call today. Crimson will maintain master keys in our on-prem HSM cluster (FIPS 140-2/3). We need to validate the ingest, attestation, minimal egress, rotation plan and audit trail before we sign the SOW.

Top questions: 1) remote attestation proof for wrapped exports, 2) exact egress IPs and mTLS requirements, 3) a rotation pattern with zero read downtime and clear rollback, 4) sample audit events showing unwrap actor mapping.

Attached is our network diagram and a draft mutual action plan.

Regards,
Jatin Patel
Head of Security Engineering, Crimson Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: J. Patel <j.patel@crimsonhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC BYO Keystore integration kickoff

Jatin 9;Thanks9; 94 summarized: we accept PKCS#11 and KMIP-wrapped blobs with vendor attestation certificates. Redwood stores only wrapped blobs + metadata; clear key material never persisted.

Egress: Redwood will publish three static egress IPs and require mTLS client certs for the ingest API. For rotation, we propose a staged ingestion + double-read cutover that allows both keys for a short window and a controlled commit step. Audit: immutable events (key_ingest, unwrap_request, rotation_commit) with actor, request_id and wrapped_key_id are exportable to your SIEM.

Proposed quick runbook:
1) Generate K2 on Crimson HSM, export wrapped blob W2 with attestation and upload via KMIP/HTTPS.
2) Redwood ingests W2, validates attestation, marks staged_key_id.
3) Cutover window: Redwood accepts both live_key_id and staged_key_id for unwraps; new encryptions use staged_key_id. After validation, commit staged_key_id to live and deprecate prior key.

Fallback: emergency split-custody escrow requiring two Crimson signoffs + Redwood CSO ack. Kimberly & Soojin will run the ops acceptance test next week.

- Diego
Product Security, Redwood Inference

Diego/Jatin 	5 vendor note: Crimson's HSM (v8.2) supports CMS-wrapped export and can produce HW-signed attestation at export time. Use RSA-OAEP wrapping and include the attestation OID. We can supply a small validation binary Crimson runs locally to produce a signed manifest. PKCS#11 sessions should be short-lived service accounts.

We can schedule a 1-hr integration session next Tue to walk KMIP payloads.

Regards,
